RenderHints.Caption: Home Health Care Services Tracking was designed as a sample database for testing tools and techniques for migrating Microsoft Access databases to other platforms (e.g., .NET).  The database contains some purposely overengineered code.  It is not intended for use in production.

DataSource.InlineSql: SELECT cb.*, Trim(Nz([c.FirstName],\"\") & ' ' & Nz([c.LastName],\"\")) AS ClientName FROM tblClientBudgets AS cb INNER JOIN tblClients AS c ON cb.ClientID = c.ClientID;

Binding.RowSource: SELECT ClientID, FirstName & ' ' & LastName AS ClientName FROM tblClients ORDER BY LastName, FirstName;
SELECT FiscalYear FROM tlkpFiscalYears ORDER BY FiscalYear DESC;
SELECT ProviderID, ProviderName FROM tblProviders ORDER BY ProviderName;
SELECT ProviderID, ProviderName FROM tblProviders ORDER BY ProviderName;
SELECT FiscalYear FROM tlkpFiscalYears ORDER BY FiscalYear DESC;
SELECT CategoryName FROM tlkpServiceCategories ORDER BY CategoryName;

DataSource.InlineSql: SELECT tblServiceRateLimits.*, tblServices.ServiceName FROM tblServiceRateLimits INNER JOIN tblServices ON tblServiceRateLimits.ServiceID = tblServices.ServiceID;

Binding.RowSource: SELECT FiscalYear FROM tlkpFiscalYears ORDER BY FiscalYear DESC;
SELECT ServiceID, ServiceName FROM tblServices ORDER BY ServiceName;

DataSource.InlineSql: SELECT tblProviders.ProviderID, tblProviders.ProviderName, tblServices.ServiceID, tblServices.ServiceName, tblClientServicePlan.FiscalYear, tblProviderServiceCatalog.RatePerHour, tblClientServicePlan.HoursPerWeek AS WeeklyHours, tblClientServicePlan.WeeklyCost, tblClientServicePlan.AnnualEstCost, tblClients.ClientID, Trim(Nz ([LastName], \"\") & \", \" & Nz ([FirstName], \"\")) AS ClientName FROM tblServices INNER JOIN (tblProviders INNER JOIN ((tblClients INNER JOIN tblClientServiceNeeds ON tblClients.ClientID = tblClientServiceNeeds.ClientID) INNER JOIN (tblProviderServiceCatalog INNER JOIN tblClientServicePlan ON tblProviderServiceCatalog.ProviderServiceCatalogID = tblClientServicePlan.ProviderServiceCatalogID) ON tblClientServiceNeeds.ClientServiceNeedID = tblClientServicePlan.ClientServiceNeedID) ON tblProviders.ProviderID = tblProviderServiceCatalog.ProviderID) ON (         tblServices.ServiceID = tblProviderServiceCatalog.ServiceID     ) AND (         tblServices.ServiceID = tblClientServiceNeeds.ServiceID     );
SELECT n.*, s.ServiceName FROM tblClientServiceNeeds AS n LEFT JOIN tblServices AS s ON n.ServiceID = s.ServiceID;
SELECT * FROM qryClientServicePlanDetail WHERE ClientID=TempVars!repCID And FiscalYear=TempVars!repFY;
SELECT * FROM qryClientNeedsNotMet WHERE ClientID=TempVars!repCID And FiscalYear=TempVars!repFY;
